title: Squeeze a line of ketchup along a hot dog from an upside-down bottle, none on the bun, then stand the bottle back
instruction: Put a line of ketchup along the sausage of the hot dog from end to end, keeping it on the sausage, then stand the ketchup bottle back on its cap where it was.
context: Dressing hot dogs, burgers and sandwiches from a squeeze bottle is a core part of fast-food and concession work. O*NET 35-3023.00 Fast Food and Counter Workers (3.9M): "Prepare daily food items, and cook simple foods and beverages, such as sandwiches, salads, soups, pizza, or coffee"; O*NET 35-2011.00 Cooks, Fast Food: "Prepare specialty foods, such as pizzas, fish and chips, sandwiches, or tacos, following specific methods that usually require short preparation time." The National Hot Dog and Sausage Council's rule: "Always 'dress the dog,' not the bun." The hand skill: one hand holds a full 0.43 kg bottle tip down by its soft walls without opening the valve (about 4 N), then keeps a steady squeeze (about 9.5 N) while carrying the nozzle 16 cm along the sausage at a matching speed, 1-2 cm above it and within 6 mm of its crest. Stopping or going slowly pools ketchup that runs onto the bun; going fast breaks the line; drifting sideways runs it down into the bun. One arm is enough.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left, z up from the table top. (1) White 9-inch (23 cm) paper plate, loose, centred at x 19.0, y -6.0. (2) Hot dog in its bun, loose, on the plate, long axis along x, centred at x 19.0, y -6.0: an all-beef frank 16 cm long, 2.2 cm across, its top 4 cm above the plate, in a split-top bun 15 cm long and 8.2 cm wide. (3) Upside-down ketchup squeeze bottle (14 oz / 397 g, like Heinz Tomato Ketchup 14 oz upside-down), full, about 0.43 kg: soft plastic body 7.6 cm (along x) by 4.8 cm (along y), 17.5 cm tall, standing on its cap (3.6 cm across) at x 17.0, y -21.5, flip lid open. Both arms start at the ready pose, grippers open. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Every control step: the bottle's wall squeeze, tilt and nozzle position. Ketchup flows only with the bottle within 60 deg of tip-down and a squeeze over 5 N (0.15 ml/s per N above 5 N), landing straight below the nozzle. The sausage is split into 16 cells of 1 cm; ketchup within 6 mm of the crest fills a cell (it holds at most 0.6 ml; the excess runs onto the bun); a cell with 0.12 ml is covered. Ketchup anywhere else is off target, 0.1 ml = a 0.4 cm^2 spot. 0 if more than 2.0 cm^2 is off target; otherwise 0.8 x min(1, L / 14 cm), L = the longest unbroken covered run; 1.0 (success, held 1 s) for L >= 14 cm, at most 0.5 cm^2 off target, the bottle standing on its cap (within 15 deg), let go (fingers 2 cm away) and still, and the hot dog still on the plate. Doing nothing scores 0. Real trial: an overhead photo with a ruler beside the hot dog: L = the length of unbroken line on top of the sausage, at least 4 mm wide; off-target spots measured length x width; the bottle's end state from the video.
reset_notes: Put a fresh frank in a fresh bun (both at room temperature, 20-24 C) on a fresh paper plate at the marked spot. Refill the bottle to its mark from a larger ketchup container, wipe its outside and nozzle, squeeze a short test line onto a waste plate so ketchup sits at the valve, and stand it on its cap at the marked spot with the lid open. Cover the table round the plate with paper. Simulation: each trial starts the simulator afresh.
fidelity: Rigid bodies, 20 Hz control. Bottle, bun, frank and plate are boxes, cylinders and capsules at true size. The bottle's two wide walls are rigid panels on 2 N/mm springs; ketchup is not simulated as a fluid: a deposition rule (flow from the walls' real squeeze, straight down from the nozzle, 1 cm cells holding at most 0.6 ml) stands in for it, shown by visual-only red marks. Real trials use real ketchup.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (the right gripper picked the bottle up and held it tipped over beside the plate for most of the run; a little ketchup landed on the table, none on the sausage); demo: 1.0
